newsitem.title: INDIA: TISCO sees 97/98 capex at 7/8 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: TISCO sees 97/98 capex at 7/8 bln rupees.

text.p: India's Tata and Iron Steel Company Ltd. (TISCO) said on Thursday it anticipated a capital expenditure of seven to eight billion rupees in the financial year 1997/98 (April-March).
"The company sees a capital expenditure plan of seven to eight billion rupees during 1997/98," TISCO chairman Ratan Tata told shareholders at the firm's annual general meeting.
The firm intended to pour a total of 30 billion rupees into capital expenditure by the year 2000, Tata added.
